title: Sugreeva's coronation
introduction: Hanuma proposes that the coronation of Sugreeva is to be performed under the aegis of Rama. But Rama says that he cannot enter villages or cities during exile, and asks the chiefs of monkeys to perform the same. Rama also suggests that Angada may also be crowned as crown prince. Accordingly, Sugreeva is anointed as king and Angada as crown prince of Kishkindha. The regal splendour of the coronation is narrated in here.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे षड् विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 26th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शोक अभिसंतप्तम् सुग्रीवम् क्लिन्न वासनम् |
शाखा मृग महामात्राः परिवार्य उपतस्थिरे
verses.iast:
tataḥ śoka abhisantaptam sugrīvam klinna vāsanam |
śākhā mṛga mahāmātrāḥ parivārya upatasthire
verses.translation: The eminent ministers of tree-branch animals then surrounded Sugreeva, who is very much seared in grief and who is still wearing damp cloths, as he just a while ago offered watery oblations to his deceased brother, stood accessible to him.

glosses.meaning: then, in grief, very much, seared
arriving around, stood nearby - stood accessible to Sugreeva.

verses.devanagari:
अभिगम्य महाबाहुम् रामम् अक्लिष्ट कारिणम् |
स्थिताः प्रांजलयः सर्वे पितामहम् इव ऋषयः
verses.iast:
abhigamya mahābāhum rāmam akliṣṭa kāriṇam |
sthitāḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve pitāmaham iva ṛṣayaḥ
verses.translation: On going towards the dexterous Rama, whose exploits are effortless, all of those monkeys tarried with their palms adjoined as with the sages tarrying in the presence of Brahma, the Forefather.

glosses.meaning: at Forefather - Brahma, sages, as with
without, complication, deeds doer - effortless, adroit

verses.devanagari:
ततः कांचन शैल आभः तरुण अर्क निभ आननः |
अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिर् वाक्यम् हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kāṃcana śaila ābhaḥ taruṇa arka nibha ānanaḥ |
abravīt prāṃjalir vākyam hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma, the son of Air-god, whose sheen is like that of the golden mountain Meru, and whose visage is like that of the tender sun in its glint, then spoke this sentence reverently adjoining his palms.

glosses.meaning: golden, mountain, [Mt. Meru] in sheen of
tender, sun, in glint, with visage
well - reverently, adjoining palms, sentence, spoke.

verses.devanagari:
भवत् प्रसादात् काकुत्स्थ पितृ पैतामहम् महत् |
वानराणाम् सुदंष्ट्राणाम् संपन्न बलशालिनाम्
महात्मानाम् सुदुष्प्रापम् प्राप्तम् राज्यम् इदम् प्रभो |
verses.iast:
bhavat prasādāt kākutstha pitṛ paitāmaham mahat |
vānarāṇām sudaṃṣṭrāṇām sampanna balaśālinām
mahātmānām suduṣ.hprāpam prāptam rājyam idam prabho |
verses.translation: "Oh, lord Rama, this magnificent kingdom of deferential monkeys who are armed with the teeth, and whose might is a privileged one - since our might is not dependent on any weapons or other tactical warfare, except our own bodily strength - and oh, Kakutstha, that which belongs to his father and forefathers, and that which is otherwise impossible for him to regain, Sugreeva regained such a kingdom with your grace.

glosses.meaning: of best, teethed monkeys [armed with the teeth, as in armed to the teeth]
of great-souled ones - rather, deferential ones

verses.devanagari:
भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रविश्य नगरम् शुभम्
संविधास्यति कार्याणि सर्वाणि ससुहृत् गणः|
स्नातो अयम् विविधैर् गन्धैर् औषधैः च यथा विधि
verses.iast:
bhavatā samanujñātaḥ praviśya nagaram śubham
saṃvidhāsyati kāryāṇi sarvāṇi sasuhṛt gaṇaḥ |
snāto ayam vividhair gandhair auṣadhaiḥ ca yathā vidhi
verses.translation: "And if you empower, this Sugreeva will enter the propitious city Kishkindha along with a group good-hearted friends, and he will get anointed procedurally with various essences and herbal-extracts as its king, and thus he can revamp all the administration.

glosses.meaning: along with, good, hearted, friend's, groups
well, authorized - if you permit, empower
all, activities, well, set right - he can revamp administration.

verses.devanagari:
अर्चयिष्यति माल्यैः च रत्नैः च त्वाम् विशेषतः |
इमाम् गिरि गुहाम् रम्याम् अभिगन्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
कुरुष्व स्वामि संबन्धम् वानरान् संप्रहर्षयन् |
verses.iast:
arcayiṣyati mālyaiḥ ca ratnaiḥ ca tvām viśeṣataḥ |
imām giri guhām ramyām abhigantum tvam arhasi
kuruṣva svāmi sambandham vānarān sampraharṣayan |
verses.translation: "He would like to honour you in a remarkable way with garlands and precious gems, hence it will be apt of you to enter this delightful mountain cave, namely Kishkindha, and you may kindly consolidate the congenial affinity between the governor and the governed for the very high exhilaration of Vanara-s." Hanuma appealed Rama in this way.

glosses.meaning: with garlands, also, with precious gems, also -with best possible
delightful one, in this, mountain, cave [Kishkindha]
make happen - you may please consolidate
for the very, high, exhilaration - of monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तो हनुमता राघवः पर वीरहा
प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तम् बुद्धिमान् वाक्य कोविदः |
verses.iast:
evam ukto hanumatā rāghavaḥ para vīrahā
pratyuvāca hanūmantam buddhimān vākya kovidaḥ |
verses.translation: When Hanuma said so, Rama the destroyer of valiant foes, an intellectual and an enunciator replied Hanuma in this way.

glosses.meaning: by Hanuma, thus, who is said - Rama
foes, valiant ones, destroyer of - Rama
in sentence making, scholar - enunciator, Rama
Raghava, to Hanuma, in reply, spoke.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य ग्रामम् वा यदि वा पुरम्
न प्रवेक्ष्यामि हनुमन् पितुर् निर्देश पालकः |
verses.iast:
caturdaśa samāḥ saumya grāmam vā yadi vā puram
na pravekṣyāmi hanuman pitur nirdeśa pālakaḥ |
verses.translation: "As a conformist to the directives of my father, oh, gentle Hanuma, I am not supposed to enter either a village or a city.

glosses.meaning: father's, directives, as a conformist to

verses.devanagari:
सुसमृद्धाम् गुहाम् दिव्याम् सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः
प्रविष्टो विधिवत् वीरः क्षिप्रम् राज्ये अभिषिच्यताम् |
verses.iast:
susamṛddhām guhām divyām sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ
praviṣṭo vidhivat vīraḥ kṣipram rājye abhiṣicyatām |
verses.translation: "As and when the best one among Vanara-s valorous Sugreeva enters the highly flourishing and statuesquely Kishkindha, he shall be enthroned in the kingdom, immediately and procedurally.

glosses.meaning: statuesque, cave - Kishkindha, one who has entered - Sugreeva
valorous one, Vanara-s, best one among, Sugreeva
in kingdom, procedurally, be anointed, enthroned.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा हनूमन्तम् रामः सुग्रीवम् अब्रवीत्
वृत्तज्ञो वृत्त संपन्नम् उदार बल विक्रमम् |
verses.iast:
evam uktvā hanūmantam rāmaḥ sugrīvam abravīt
vṛttajño vṛtta sampannam udāra bala vikramam |
verses.translation: Replying Hanuma thus, that knower of the etiquette Rama, also spoke to Sugreeva, who is rich in politesse and an imposing one by his might and valour.

glosses.meaning: to Hanuma, this way, on saying
imposing, by might, by valour - Sugreeva

verses.devanagari:
इमम् अपि अंगदम् वीरम् यौवराज्ये अभिषेचय
ज्येष्ठस्य हि सुतो ज्येष्ठः सदृशो विक्रमेण च |
अंगदो अयम् अदीनात्मा यौवराज्यस्य भाजनम्
verses.iast:
imam api aṃgadam vīram yauvarājye abhiṣecaya
jyeṣṭhasya hi suto jyeṣṭhaḥ sadṛśo vikrameṇa ca |
aṃgado ayam adīnātmā yauvarājyasya bhājanam
verses.translation: "You may even crown this brave Angada as crown prince, he is the eldest son of your elder brother, his bravery is kindred to that of his father, and thus this enthusiastic Angada will be a well-chosen designee for the crown-princeship.
notes: The eldest son with kingly merits, though parented by an elder brother, need be crowned as crown prince anena jyṣṭho guṇavān jyeṣṭha bhrātṛ putro api yauva rājye abhiṣecanīya iti uktam - dharmakūtamThe whole Maha Bharata is based on this rule till a gruesome war has chanced.

glosses.meaning: in crown princedom, you crown him
by bravery, similar to, even [ to Vali, or to you]
not, pathetic, at heart - enthusiastic one, Angada on becoming]

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वो अयम् वार्षिको मासः श्रावणः सलिल आगमः |
प्रवृत्ताः सौम्य चत्वारो मासा वार्षिक संज्ञिताः
verses.iast:
pūrvo ayam vārṣiko māsaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ salila āgamaḥ |
pravṛttāḥ saumya catvāro māsā vārṣika saṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: "The four month period specified for rainy season has commenced, oh gentle Sugreeva, and this is shravaNa, the first month of rainy season that brings many showers.
notes: This month śrvaṇa, compares nearly with July-August months. There are elaborate accounts for calculating the duration of Ramayana basing on the months indicated here and there, and they cannot be included here for these calculations vary in themselves. The Hindu seasons are six as detailed in Bala Kanda 1-12-1.

glosses.meaning: of rainy season, indicated as - months specified as rainy season

verses.devanagari:
न अयम् उद्योग समयः प्रविश त्वम् पुरीम् शुभाम् |
अस्मिन् वत्स्यामि अहम् सौम्य पर्वते सह लक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
na ayam udyoga samayaḥ praviśa tvam purīm śubhām |
asmin vatsyāmi aham saumya parvate saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "This is not a time for any striving, hence you enter the propitious city Kishkindha, oh, gentle Sugreeva, and I for my part will stay on this mountain along with Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: on this, mountain, I will stay.

verses.devanagari:
इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता |
प्रभूत सलिला सौम्य प्रभूत कमल उत्पला
verses.iast:
iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā |
prabhūta salilā saumya prabhūta kamala utpalā
verses.translation: "This mountain cave is heart-pleasing by being spacious with worthwhile breeze, oh, gentle one, water is copious and red and blue lotuses are aplenty about this place.

verses.devanagari:
कार्तिके समनुप्राप्ते त्वम् रावण वधे यत |
एष नः समयः सौम्य प्रविश त्वम् स्वम् आलयम्
अभिषिंचस्व राज्ये च सुहृदः संप्रहर्षय |
verses.iast:
kārtike samanuprāpte tvam rāvaṇa vadhe yata |
eṣa naḥ samayaḥ saumya praviśa tvam svam ālayam
abhiṣiṃcasva rājye ca suhṛdaḥ sampraharṣaya |
verses.translation: "On the advent of kaartika month, October, say post-rainy season, you shall do your best in the cause of Ravana's elimination, and this is our covenant, and hence oh, gentle Sugreeva, for now enter your mansion, be enthroned in kingdom as well, and exhilarate your friends."

glosses.meaning: kaartika month, well, near, on the advent of
you, for Ravana's, in the matter of elimination, make effort
you, your own, mansion enter - for now
in kingdom, be enthroned, as well

verses.devanagari:
इति राम अभ्यनुज्ञातः सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः
प्रविवेश पुरीम् रम्याम् किष्किंधाम् वालि पालिताम् |
verses.iast:
iti rāma abhyanujñātaḥ sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ
praviveśa purīm ramyām kiṣkiṃdhām vāli pālitām |
verses.translation: Thus when Rama countenanced that best vanara Sugreeva entered the charming city Kishkindha which is so far ruled by Vali.

glosses.meaning: thus, by Rama, well, permitted - countenanced in

verses.devanagari:
तम् वानर सहस्राणि प्रविष्टम् वानर ईश्वरम्
अभिवार्य प्रहृष्टानि सर्वतः प्लवगेश्वरम् |
verses.iast:
tam vānara sahasrāṇi praviṣṭam vānara īśvaram
abhivārya prahṛṣṭāni sarvataḥ plavageśvaram |
verses.translation: When the sovereign of vanara-s Sugreeva has entered the city, very gladly thousands of vanara-s have also entered and fenced off that lord of fly-jumpers from all over.

glosses.meaning: from all over, fly-jumper's, lord of
vanara-s, in thousands, who have [also] entered
gathered round - they fenced him in.]

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वा दृष्ट्वा हरि गण ईश्वरम्
प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पतिता वसुधायाम् समाहिताः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvā dṛṣṭvā hari gaṇa īśvaram
praṇamya mūrdhnā patitā vasudhāyām samāhitāḥ |
verses.translation: All the inmates and ministers in Kishkindha then revered the lord of monkey throngs Sugreeva with their head-bent, and they have also prostrated before him with an assiduously polite attitude.

glosses.meaning: all, natives - inmates and ministers in Kishkindha

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवः प्रकृतीः सर्वाः संभाष्य उत्थाप्य वीर्यवान्
भ्रातुर् अंतः पुरम् सौम्यम् प्रविवेश महाबलः |
verses.iast:
sugrīvaḥ prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ sambhāṣya utthāpya vīryavān
bhrātur aṃtaḥ puram saumyam praviveśa mahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: Raising the rank-and-file members from their prostration, and on exchanging a word or two with them, that valiant and highly mighty Sugreeva entered the beautiful palace-chambers of his brother.

glosses.meaning: all, rank-and-file members, on raising them up
brother's, beautiful [not gentle here,] inner, palace - palace-chambers, entered.

verses.devanagari:
प्रविष्टम् भीम विक्रांतम् सुग्रीवम् वानरर्षभम्
अभ्यषिंचंत सुहृदः सहस्राक्षम् इव अमराः |
verses.iast:
praviṣṭam bhīma vikrāṃtam sugrīvam vānararṣabham
abhyaṣiṃcaṃta suhṛdaḥ sahasrākṣam iva amarāḥ |
verses.translation: When that prodigiously venturesome arch-vanara Sugreeva has entered the palace his cohorts anointed him as gods would anoint the Thousand-eyed Indra.

glosses.meaning: gods, thousand, eyed one - Indra, as with.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य पाण्डुरम् आजह्रुः छत्रम् हेम परिष्कृतम्
शुक्ले च वाल व्यजने हेम दण्डे यशस्करे |
तथा सर्वाणि रत्नानि सर्व बीज औषधानि च
स क्षीराणाम् च वृक्षाणाम् प्ररोहान् कुसुमानि च |
शुक्लानि चैव वस्त्राणि श्वेतम् चैव अनुलेपनम्
सुगंधीनि च माल्यानि स्थलजानि अंबुजानि च |
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि गन्धाम् च विविधान् बहून्
अक्षतम् जात रूपम् च प्रियंगु मधु सर्पिषी |
दधि चर्म च वैयाघ्रम् परार्ध्ये च अपि उपानहौ
समालंभनम् आदाय गोरोचनम् मनः शिलाम् |
आजग्मुः तत्र मुदिता वराः कन्याः च षोडश
verses.iast:
tasya pāṇḍuram ājahruḥ chatram hema pariṣ.hkṛtam
śukle ca vāla vyajane hema daṇḍe yaśaskare |
tathā sarvāṇi ratnāni sarva bīja auṣadhāni ca
sa kṣīrāṇām ca vṛkṣāṇām prarohān kusumāni ca |
śuklāni caiva vastrāṇi śvetam caiva anulepanam
sugaṃdhīni ca mālyāni sthalajāni ambujāni ca |
candanāni ca divyāni gandhām ca vividhān bahūn
akṣatam jāta rūpam ca priyaṃgu madhu sarpiṣī |
dadhi carma ca vaiyāghram parārdhye ca api upānahau
samālambhanam ādāya gorocanam manaḥ śilām |
ājagmuḥ tatra muditā varāḥ kanyāḥ ca ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: A white parasol highly ornate in gold, long-furred royal-fans with golden handles that are the enhancers of celebrity are brought for Sugreeva's anointment. Likewise, on taking all kinds of jewels, seeds, herbs, sprouts of trees that are still exuding milky latex, also flowers, and white royal-robes and white body-cream, lotuses bloomed on dry-land, best sandal paste, also various and numerous perfumes, Holy-yellow-rice, gold, seeds that are small and fragrant called priyangu, honey, ghee, curds, skin of tiger, tassels of fragrant flowers, and invaluable sandal shoes, unguents before oil bath, orpiment preparations one in yellow called gorochana, and the other in red called Manshila, there arrived sixteen best and cheerful damsels.

glosses.meaning: with, milky exude [latex,] of trees, sprouts
on earth, [birthed] bloomed, in water-bloomed - lotuses, lotuses bloomed on dry-land, also
fully, over, spreading-paste - unguents, paste spread on body before oil bath
gorocana - yellow arsenic, orpiment from animal
mind, stone - realgar, red arsenic, another orpiment for using as tilaka]

verses.devanagari:
ततः ते वानर श्रेष्ठम् अभिषेक्तुम् यथा विधि |
रत्नैर् वस्त्रैः च भक्ष्यैः च तोषयित्वा द्विजर्षभान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ te vānara śreṣṭham abhiṣektum yathā vidhi |
ratnair vastraiḥ ca bhakṣyaiḥ ca toṣayitvā dvijarṣabhān
verses.translation: They the Vanara-s have then started to anoint that best Vanara Sugreeva according to the tradition, having appeased the eminent Brahmans with jewels, garments and delicacies.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुश परिस्तीर्णम् समिद्धम् जात वेदसम् |
मंत्र पूतेन हविषा हुत्वा मंत्रविदो जनाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kuśa paristīrṇam samiddham jāta vedasam |
maṃtra pūtena haviṣā hutvā maṃtravido janāḥ
verses.translation: Authoritative scholars in Vedic-hymns then spreading the ritual grass around the Fire-altar which is with enkindled Ritual-fire oblated fire oblations into it duly sanctifying them with hymns.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हेम प्रतिष्ठाने वर आस्तरण संवृते |
प्रासाद शिखरे रम्ये चित्र माल्य उपशोभिते
प्राङ्मुखम् विधिवत् मंत्रैः स्थापयित्वा वर आसने |
नदी नदेभ्यः संहृत्य तीर्थेभ्यः च समंततः
आहृत्य च समुद्रेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो वानरर्षभाः |
अपः कनक कुंभेषु निधाय विमलम् जलम्
शुभैः वृषभ शृन्गैः च कलशैः च एव कांचनैः |
शास्त्र दृष्टेन विधिना महर्षि विहितेन च
गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गंधमादनः |
मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव हनूमान् जांबवान् तथा
अभ्यषिंचंत सुग्रीवम् प्रसन्नेन सुगंधिना |
सलिलेन सहस्राक्षम् वसवो वासवम् यथा
verses.iast:
tato hema pratiṣṭhāne vara āstaraṇa saṃvṛte |
prāsāda śikhare ramye citra mālya upaśobhite
prāñmukham vidhivat maṃtraiḥ sthāpayitvā vara āsane |
nadī nadebhyaḥ saṃhṛtya tīrthebhyaḥ ca samaṃtataḥ
āhṛtya ca samudrebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vānararṣabhāḥ |
apaḥ kanaka kumbheṣu nidhāya vimalam jalam
śubhaiḥ vṛṣabha śṛngaiḥ ca kalaśaiḥ ca eva kāṃcanaiḥ |
śāstra dṛṣṭena vidhinā maharṣi vihitena ca
gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gaṃdhamādanaḥ |
maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva hanūmān jāmbavān tathā
abhyaṣiṃcaṃta sugrīvam prasannena sugaṃdhinā |
salilena sahasrākṣam vasavo vāsavam yathā
verses.translation: On a splendid, choicest and finely upholstered throne with golden legs that is kept atop a rostrum that is shining forth with various flower tassels, Sugreeva is procedurally inducted to sit facing east to the chanting of Vedic hymns. Then, Vanara-s like Gaja, Gavaaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha, Gandhamaadana, Mainda, Dvividha, also thus Hanuma, Jambavanta have started pouring pure water on Sugreeva, which the best vanara-s have collected from the rivers flowing to east, as well as to west, from each of the sacred-declivity of rivers, from every ocean, and stored in golden flasks. Thus those have anointed Sugreeva with those pellucid and well-perfumed waters poured from golden vessels through the auspicious horns of bulls as revealed in scriptures and as great sages have defined, which anointment is like eight of Vasu-gods anointing the Thousand-eyed Indra.
notes: Hindu tradition draws its methodology of religious ceremonies mainly from two sources śruti Veda-s, and smṛti, sūtra-s rules framed by sages. In the above verse it is said that water is poured through the horns of bulls. It is a practise to do so to achieve religious merit. So also bathing God Shiva through the horn of rhino is said to be the highest method of abhiṣeka anointment.

glosses.meaning: on a beautiful, a raised platform for spectators - rostrum
one a golden, pedestal - a throne with golden standard - legs
best, overlain - throne overlain with best upholstery
on a splendid, choicest, seat - throne
east, facing, on establishing - making him to sit
from eastward rivers, from westward rivers
from everywhere, from sacred declivities - bath places of rivers, also
all of the, from oceans, also

glosses.itrans: gajaH gavaakSaH gavayaH sharabhaH gandhamaadanaH maindaH dvividaH
glosses.iast: gajaḥ gavākṣaḥ gavayaḥ śarabhaḥ gandhamādanaḥ maindaḥ dvividaḥ
glosses.devanagari: गजः गवाक्षः गवयः शरभः गन्धमादनः मैन्दः द्विविदः
glosses.meaning: Gaja, Gavaaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha, Gandhamaadana, Mainda, Dvivida

verses.devanagari:
अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः |
प्रचुक्रुशुर् महात्मानो हृष्टाः शत सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
abhiṣikte tu sugrīve sarve vānara puṃgavāḥ |
pracukruśur mahātmāno hṛṣṭāḥ śata sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Hundreds and thousands of the great-souled and prominent vanara-s that are there, all of them have cheerily raised high hullabaloos while Sugreeva is anointed.

glosses.meaning: cheerily = pra cukrushuH = highly, shouted - chattered, raised hullabaloos.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य तु वचः कुर्वन् सुग्रीवो हरि पुंगवः |
अंगदम् संपरिष्वज्य यौवराज्ये अभिषेचयत्
verses.iast:
rāmasya tu vacaḥ kurvan sugrīvo hari puṅgavaḥ |
aṃgadam sampariṣvajya yauvarājye abhiṣecayat
verses.translation: The best one among monkeys Sugreeva graciously embraced Angada and anointed his as crown prince in order to effectuate Rama's word.

verses.devanagari:
अंगदे च अभिषिक्ते तु सानुक्रोशाः प्लवंगमाः |
साधु साधु इति सुग्रीवम् महात्मानो हि अपूजयन्
verses.iast:
aṃgade ca abhiṣikte tu sānukrośāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ |
sādhu sādhu iti sugrīvam mahātmāno hi apūjayan
verses.translation: On the anointment of Angada those fly-jumpers that have sympathy for him have acclaimed Sugreeva saying, 'well done, well done.'

glosses.meaning: on Angada, also, when anointed, but
with, entailing, sadness - those that are sympathetic to Angada

verses.devanagari:
रामम् च एव महात्मानम् लक्ष्मणम् च पुनः पुनः |
प्रीताः च तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिनि
verses.iast:
rāmam ca eva mahātmānam lakśmaṇam ca punaḥ punaḥ |
prītāḥ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve tādṛśe tatra vartini
verses.translation: While that kind of pompous anointment is taking place all are gladdened and that way they repeatedly extolled the great-souled Rama, and even Lakshmana too.

verses.devanagari:
हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकीर्णा पताका ध्वज शोभिता |
बभूव नगरी रम्या क्षिकिंधा गिरि गह्वरे
verses.iast:
hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana ākīrṇā patākā dhvaja śobhitā |
babhūva nagarī ramyā kṣikiṃdhā giri gahvare
verses.translation: That magnificent city Kishkindha situated in the cave of mountain which is already splendorous with flags of triumph and banners is further splendorous with blithe and burly monkeys overspreading it.

glosses.meaning: with flags [of triumph,] flag staffs, splendorous
with blithe, bulgy, people - monkeys, overspread with.

verses.devanagari:
निवेद्य रामाय तदा महात्मने
महा अभिषेकम् कपि वाहनी पतिः |
रुमाम् च भार्याम् उपलभ्य वीर्यवान्
अवाप राज्यम् त्रिदश अधिपो यथा
verses.iast:
nivedya rāmāya tadā mahātmane
mahā abhiṣekam kapi vāhanī patiḥ |
rumām ca bhāryām upalabhya vīryavān
avāpa rājyam tridaśa adhipo yathā
verses.translation: The valiant Sugreeva who is by now the king of monkeys army, then apprised the great-souled Rama about his grand anointment, and thus he not only regained his wife Ruma but also secured the kingdom, like the chief of divinities Indra.

glosses.meaning: to great, souled one, to Rama
